questions.original: yasta to pintao yo no veo bien
questions.issue: 'pintao' unclear: painted/made-up, or high/trippy (colourful vision). Rendered literally.

questions.original: sin pasar x la olla voy
questions.issue: 'pasar por la olla' not a known idiom to me; rendered literally ('without going through the pot'). Maybe 'olla' = head or a drug-related pot.

questions.original: voy to moñeko esa es la verda
questions.issue: 'moñeko' probably 'muñeco' (doll/puppet) or 'moñeco' (out of it); rendered 'all dolled up'.

questions.original: Sirenita voy al toke lucecita todo loke
questions.issue: 'todo loke' = 'todo lo que' but with no continuation; may be 'todo loco'. Rendered 'all of it'.

questions.original: Tas fumando un piti-no tienes mi bombón
questions.issue: Hyphen 'piti-no tienes' unclear; read as 'piti, no tienes mi bombón'.

questions.original: En los coches choke, tiritando e la gustera
questions.issue: 'gustera' unknown, guessed as a word for pleasure ('gustito'); rendered 'with pleasure'.

questions.original: Por bulerias te entro a baila me ponen a camela
questions.issue: 'me ponen a camela' unclear: 'camela' = love/swoon in caló, or 'a camelo' (sweet-talk). Rendered 'they make me swoon'.
harrijasotzaile = stone-lifter (Basque rural sport). Rendered 'g-string stone-lifter'; the Basque word stays as pun on strength.

questions.original: yo me enamoré en terapia de choque
questions.issue: Pun between 'coches de choque' (bumper cars) and 'terapia de choque' (shock therapy); English cannot keep the same word 'choque' in both.
'eguzkilore' = sun-flower, also the carline thistle hung on Basque doors for protection. Kept the Basque word.

questions.original: ez bitarra viene se mueve recabrón
questions.issue: Mixed-language line: 'ez bitarra' (non-binary) + Spanish. Treated as Spanish, kept 'ez bitarra' in the Basque version.

questions.original: qué pasa si te monto en el ratón maricón
questions.issue: 'montar' = to give a ride / to mount (sexual) and 'ratón' = the ride; double meaning. 'maricón' rendered 'faggot' (reclaimed).
